column1: 5.5.4.2.25.4 Tabular Display. Parameters of all the intercepted emitters shall be
presented in textual format in ‘Tabular Display’ mode, as shown in Figure-5.253. The
colour codes and identification scheme for displaying emitters in this display shall be same
as that of ‘Tactical & Situational Display’. ‘Tabular Display’ shall include ‘Emitter Report
Window’ & ‘Latest Emitters Window’ which are described below.
